# THE AUTHORITATIVE WHOLE-DEFINITION BOUNDARIES, DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY
# BY TWO METHODS THAT SHARE NO CODE.
# METHOD 1: the compiled PolyC scanner
#   tools/quality/a64-cmp-cc-contract-correction01-verify.HC, mode
#   `scan`. It is a byte-level lexical state machine that tracks line
#   comments, block comments, string literals, character literals and
#   brace nesting. It does NOT match the first brace.
# METHOD 2: POSIX grep -n + wc -c + awk (masking strings and comments)
#   + shasum -a 256. It locates the declaration by a fixed-string
#   match, computes byte offsets from line lengths, and counts braces
#   on a masked copy of each line.
# RANGE CONVENTION (Convention A, adopted and frozen by this ACT):
#   the range is the ZERO-BASED HALF-OPEN interval [start, end) where
#   `start` is the first byte of the declaration and `end` is the byte
#   IMMEDIATELY AFTER the function's closing '}'. The closing '}' is
#   therefore the LAST byte of the range; the line terminator that
#   follows it is NOT part of the range.
# The two methods AGREE BYTE-FOR-BYTE on all three boundaries and all
# three digests. Neither method consults the other's output.

# IMPLEMENT02's committed C0 audit reported the whole-definition
# are FOUR BYTES SHORT of the boundaries derived here, and this ACT
# does NOT silently adopt either table: it derives the boundaries
# again, by two independent methods, and records BOTH.
# The four-byte difference is EXACTLY the difference between ending the
# range at the closing brace's LINE TERMINATOR and ending it at the
# byte before that terminator. The byte layout is:
